samples.summary: Board toolbar reuses the slides `TextEditSection`, so the new hard-coded `showRemoveLink` button ships on the Board surface too — a surface none of the diff's rationale considers
samples.evidence: `packages/frontend/src/app/board/board-toolbar.tsx:38` imports `TextEditSection` from `../slides/toolbar/text-edit-section` and renders it at :444 for `state.kind === 'text-edit'`. The diff hard-codes `showRemoveLink` inside that component (`text-edit-section.tsx:93`), so Board's text-edit toolbar silently gains a Remove-link button; the caller has no say. It is functional (Board uses the same `SlidesTextBoxEditor`, which exposes `removeLink` at `packages/slides/src/view/editor/text-box-editor.ts:650`), but every justifying comment (`text-edit-section.tsx:22-25`, `slides-view.tsx:746-750`, `text-format-group.tsx:59-71`) talks only about Slides, so Board's toolbar change is unreviewed. Fix belongs on the new code: pass the prop from the shell, or extend the rationale to Board.

samples.summary: The third Clear-formatting entry point (docs/slides text-box `clearInlineFormatting`) did not get the trailing-edge `href` override the other two did; harmless only because its collapsed-caret path no-ops
samples.evidence: `packages/docs/src/view/text-box-editor.ts:1077-1082` still calls `applyStyleImpl(CLEAR_INLINE_STYLE)` bare, while `editor.ts:3362-3372` and `text-editor.ts:3438-3450` now add `href: undefined` at a link's trailing edge. Nothing breaks today because `applyStyleImpl` early-returns without a selection (`text-box-editor.ts:820`), so no caret-derived style is staged. But the invariant the diff states — every caller storing a caret-derived style must consult `isAtLinkTrailingEdge` (`caret-style.ts:60-68`) — is unhonoured here, and this factory already has a collapsed-caret pending path elsewhere (`stepSelectionFontSizeImpl`, :870-887), so the next one added will silently extend links. It also leaves the two Slides halves inconsistent: toolbar Clear-formatting at a collapsed caret does nothing, while Cmd+\ (shared `TextEditor` built at :669) stages the cleared style.

samples.summary: Cmd+\ inside Slides/Board text boxes now also clears fontSize/fontFamily/color/backgroundColor — a behaviour change on surfaces outside packages/docs, framed in the diff only as a docs drift fix
samples.evidence: `TextEditor` is instantiated by the docs text-box factory (`packages/docs/src/view/text-box-editor.ts:669`), which powers Slides/Board text boxes, shape text and table cells (`packages/slides/src/view/editor/text-box-editor.ts:623`). Collapsing the shortcut onto `CLEAR_INLINE_STYLE` (`text-editor.ts:3453` range path, :3442-3450 pending path) means Cmd+\ there now strips font family, font size and colours, falling back to docs defaults (`DEFAULT_INLINE_STYLE` 11pt/Arial, theme defaults in `paint-layout.ts:433-454`) rather than the slide theme's implied values. The toolbar button already did this, so it is parity, but no Slides-side coverage or note exists for the shortcut's widened key set; theme-sized placeholder text is the likeliest visible regression.

samples.summary: New comment justifies `findBlock` over `getBlock` with a claim the model contradicts — `Doc.getBlock` already resolves header, footer and table-cell blocks
samples.evidence: `packages/docs/src/model/caret-style.ts:67-69` claims "`findBlock` (not `getBlock`) so a caret in a header, footer or table cell resolves too". `Doc.getBlock` (`packages/docs/src/model/document.ts:202-216`) searches body, header, footer and `findBlockInCells` before throwing, so the only difference from the relocated private `TextEditor.isAtLinkTrailingEdge` (which caught the throw) is the missing try/catch — behaviour of `exitLinkIfAtTrailingEdge` (`text-editor.ts:5912`) is unchanged. Only the stated reason is wrong, and it will mislead the next reader about which lookup reaches which regions.

mergedFrom.summary: New Slides "Remove link" button is wired to a caret-only `removeLink()`, so it silently no-ops when the user selects the linked text (the natural gesture) and the caret/focus lands outside the link run

finding.summary: New Slides "Remove link" button is the only way to drop an href there, but the underlying `removeLink()` is caret-only and silently no-ops for the natural "select the linked text, click Remove link" gesture
finding.evidence: `TextFormatGroup` now renders an always-enabled Remove-link button for Slides (`packages/frontend/src/components/text-formatting/text-format-group.tsx:176`, opted in at `packages/frontend/src/app/slides/toolbar/text-edit-section.tsx:93` and `mobile-toolbar.tsx:580`). It forwards to `SlidesTextBoxEditor.removeLink` (`packages/slides/src/view/editor/text-box-editor.ts:650`) → docs `TextBoxEditorAPI.removeLink` (`packages/docs/src/view/text-box-editor.ts:1234-1248`), which resolves the link purely from `cursor.position` via `findLinkRunAt` (`packages/docs/src/view/link-run.ts:33-58`) and returns early when the caret is not inside/at the edge of a linked run. In docs this was safe because Remove link is only offered from the link popover, which appears only when the caret is in a link; the Slides button has no such gate (the diff's own comment at text-format-group.tsx:167-172 says it is deliberately never gated). A user who drag-selects text that extends past the link (focus lands in a non-link run) gets a silent no-op, and since #1051 Clear formatting no longer removes links, there is no fallback path in Slides. Fix belongs either on `removeLink` (use the selection range when one exists) or on the new button's enablement/feedback.

verdict.reason: Verified independently. docs `TextBoxEditorAPI.removeLink` (packages/docs/src/view/text-box-editor.ts:1234-1248) is caret-only: it calls findLinkRunAt(block, cursor.position.offset) and returns early when no run is found, with no selection branch (contrast insertLink at :1187-1188 which does branch on selection). findLinkRunAt (packages/docs/src/view/link-run.ts:33-58) only matches the inline containing/edge-touching that offset, and expandRangeForLinks (link-run.ts:207-233 with interiorLinkRunAt at :155-159) snaps only endpoints strictly interior to a link, so a drag whose focus lands in a following non-link run is left alone. The shared TextEditor used by slides text boxes (instantiated at packages/docs/src/view/text-box-editor.ts:669) sets cursor to the selection focus (packages/docs/src/view/text-editor.ts:2373-2377), so cursor.position is outside the link and removeLink no-ops silently. The new Remove-link button is real and ungated: handler at packages/frontend/src/components/text-formatting/text-format-group.tsx:168-178 (comment says it is deliberately not gated), rendered at :310-325 with only `disabled={isDisabled}`, opted in by slides at text-edit-section.tsx:93 and mobile-toolbar.tsx:580, forwarding through packages/slides/src/view/editor/text-box-editor.ts:650-652. No fallback exists: CLEAR_INLINE_STYLE omits href by design (packages/docs/src/model/types.ts:287-315) and clearInlineFormatting routes through it (packages/docs/src/view/text-box-editor.ts:1077-1081). Docs itself only offers Remove link from the caret-gated popover (packages/frontend/src/app/docs/docs-link-popover.tsx:154). Reachable, silent, in-lane (new consumer relies on an implicit caret-only precondition), and major.
